chunks: You know and have known already those among you who had broken the sanctity of the Sabbath, and to whom We had said: 'Become (like) apes despised,'
ai.seo_question: Who were the people who broke the Sabbath and what was their punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific transgression of Bani Israel who fished on the Sabbath, turning the day of rest into a marketplace, which led to their transformation into 'qiradah' (apes) as a sign of losing their human dignity. This event is often cited by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Majlisi to illustrate the consequences of violating divine commands through both action and intent, serving as a cautionary tale for the faithful regarding the sanctity of time and worship.
